div.font: Figure. Ancestry inference pipeline. Query and reference MatrixTables are merged, filtered to ancestry-informative biallelic SNPs, optionally LD-pruned, and projected via HWE-normalized PCA. A Random Forest classifier trained on reference populations predicts ancestry for query samples with confidence-based assignment thresholds.
